The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’ ”
Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea, have replenished.

definitions.short: properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land , a coast , an island
definitions.full: H339. i I. אִי noun masculine Isa 20:5 ( feminine 23:2 ) coast, region 339 (contracted from אֱוִי so Ol § 152 b ; place whither one betakes oneself for resting, etc., originally from mariner's standpoint) — אִי absolute 20:6 +; construct Jer 47:4 ; ( Job 22:30 see below IV. אִי compare Di) plural אִיִּים Psa 72:10 +; אִיִּן Ezek 26:18 (Co איים ) אִיֵּי Gen 10:5 +; — coast, border, region (mostly late), of Philistia & Phenicia with adjacent country Isa 20:6 ; 23:2 , 6 ; so of Caphtor (= Crete) Jer 47:4 ; הַיָּם בְּעֵבֶר אֲשֶׁר הָאִי מַלְכֵי 25:22 ; elswhere plural, coasts of Chittim 2:10 ; Ezek 27:6 , of Elishah 27:7 ; different countries (on or in sea) 27:3 ; 27:15 ; 27:35 ; 26:15 , 18 (twice in verse) (last strike out Co compare ᵐ5 ) compare 39:6 , so also הַגּוֺיִם אִיֵּי Gen 10:5 (P); particular הַיָּם אִיֵּי = coast-lands & islands Isa 11:11 ; 24:15 , || הָאָרֶץ Est 10:1 ; see (without הַיָּם ) Dan 11:18 , & Psa 72:10 ; so often Isa 2 including inhabitants, 41:1 , 5 ; 42:4 , 10 ( וְישְׁבֵיהֶם אִיִּים || וּמְלֹאוֺ הַיָּם ) Isa 42:12 ; 49:1 ; 51:5 ; 59:18 ; 60:9 ; 66:19 ; compare Jer 31:10 ; Psa 97:1 ; Zeph 2:11 ( הַגּוֺיִם אִיֵּי ); islands , distinctly (taken up by ׳א as little things) Isa 40:15 ; coasts, banks , i.e. habitable lands 42:15 (|| נְהָרוֺת ). I. אִי noun masculine isle, coast , see I. אָוָה .
